title: Idle-wait Stop after an Engram admission Stop consumes the waits in a second, separate commit
outcome: From the round-3 review of w-f917452faa71 (Claude delegation-8250851e, Low, src/session_lifecycle.rs request_stop_session). When stop_waiting_engram_admission or stop_engram_abort_retry answers a Stop, stop_pending_waits_after_admission_stop consumes the session's pending waits in a second commit. If that commit fails, the route answers 500 although the admission Stop is already durable, and the waits are restored. A retried Stop then takes the Brake path and appends a "Turn stopped by user." message the first attempt left out. A crash between the two commits leaves the waits pending behind the latch. Fix direction: fold the wait consumption into the admission/retry commit, or return the admission snapshot with a non-fatal warning, and test the failure case.
acceptance: Idle-wait Stop after an Engram admission Stop consumes the waits in a second, separate commit is done
